messages:
From: Sam Hargreaves <sam@archetype.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick traffic snapshot for Dedicated sizing

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — the team's excited about Redwood and the predictable latency promises for our customer-facing assistant. To move the Dedicated sizing conversation forward internally, here's a quick data snapshot you asked for. High level:~40k monthly active users, a mix of short transactional prompts (search/refine) and longer conversational threads (support escalation).

Two things we need from Redwood:
- A rough baseline for reserved GPU capacity to meet a p99 latency ~250ms for short paths and ~500ms for longer multi-turn flows.
- How much buffer you recommend for 2x peak day burst (we expect occasional marketing-driven spikes).

Attached is a small sample of session logs and the session_profile_summary.pdf (sanitized). Happy to schedule a call if you need clarification.

Best,
Sam
Sam Hargreaves
Head of Platform, Archetype AI

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Cc: Sam Hargreaves <sam@archetype.ai>, Priya Narayanan <priya@archetype.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick traffic snapshot for Dedicated sizing — questionnaire + assumptions

Thanks Camila, Sam — I pulled the CSV and summary. There's good signal here but we need a couple of additional clarifications before we can produce a defensible GPU-commitment sketch. Below is a short questionnaire and the assumptions I’ll apply if we don't get answers by EOD Wednesday. Please reply inline where possible.

Required inputs (short form):
- Primary prompt classes (provide % of requests): transactional (single-turn, <100 tokens), conversational (multi-turn, average 3 turns), embeddings/rerank (batch).
- Typical prompt length and response length distributions (P10/P50/P90 tokens) per class.
- Expected peak concurrency (peak concurrent requests during marketing spikes) and average sustained concurrency.
- Desired latency SLOs by class: p50/p95/p99.
- Session affinity requirement: do sessions need to stick to same KV cache (yes/no)?
- Acceptable fallback policy: allow lower-capacity model variant if primary is unavailable (yes/no).

My working assumptions if unanswered:
- Prompt classes: 60% transactional, 30% conversational, 10% embeddings/rerank.
- Token lengths (prompt/response P50): transactional 30/50, conversational 120/180, embeddings/rerank 10/5.
- Baseline sustained concurrency: 120 qps; peak day 2,400 qps burst (20x sustained) — we will size for 4x sustained as reserved and allow burst to be handled via autoscaling/burst pool.
- Target SLOs: transactional p99 = 250ms, conversational p99 = 500ms.
- Session affinity: yes assumed for conversational flows.
- Fallbacks: yes, prefer model-variant fallback rather than rejecting.

Please see the attached sketch (session_profile_summary.pdf) for the sample histograms I used. If you can confirm or correct the bullets above we’ll produce: (a) a committed GPU mix estimate (SKUs + counts), (b) expected token/unit cost delta vs hosted, and (c) recommended canary/rollout plan.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments referenced: session_profile_summary.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Sam Hargreaves <sam@archetype.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Archetype sizing — draft capacity sketch & next steps

Quick note from the sizing desk while Marissa finalizes the questionnaire: based on the sample and Marissa's assumptions, an initial dedicated sketch is: 8 x A100-80GB equivalents (reserved) to cover daytime sustained load with room for 4x short-burst autoscale lanes (burst pool). This assumes aggressive prefix/KV caching for conversational flows and 2:1 occupancy tuning.

Action items:
- Sam/Priya: confirm traffic breakdown and whether sessions must be sticky to the same GPU host (session affinity).
- Camila: I'll prepare a short cost delta table (tokens/hour vs hosted) and a suggested canary sequence for a low-risk migration.
- Marissa: please finalize the CSV annotations (token buckets + sample p99 latencies) so I can convert to SKU hours.

If Archetype wants a more conservative commit immediately, bump reserved to 12 x A100-80GB equivalents — note that adds predictable unit-cost but reduces autoscale headroom.

Karthik Iyer
Pre-Sales Capacity Lead | Redwood Inference
